answer: A practical sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation with slashing: each agent locks tokens behind its registered identity, so creating clones costs real capital. Honest agents grow like a grove, their shared attestations compounding trust over time, while fakes stay thin as a plume of smoke and fade when challenged. A single ivory-tower registry would fail, so verification stays distributed: peers audit work, and proven abuse burns the attacker's stake, making sybil farming unprofitable.
